summary: @or-sdk/agents preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-prefixed identifiers and string-dictionary indirection; at install time it downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary on a sibling file `math_init.js`, a ~727 KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, single-line shuffled numeric/string opcode table). Neither the install-time script nor the executed bundle has a readable behavior that aligns with the package's advertised REST agents SDK purpose. Installing the package therefore runs an opaque, obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime that evades inspection of Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
